sources.title: Jami at-Tirmidhi 82 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Busrah's hadith: whoever touches his penis is not to pray until he performs wudu; hasan sahih per at-Tirmidhi; Darussalam sahih.

sources.title: Jami at-Tirmidhi 84 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Scholars holding wudu is required (Companions, Successors, al-Awza'i, ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, Ishaq); al-Bukhari's and Abu Zur'ah's assessments.

sources.title: Jami at-Tirmidhi 85 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Talq's hadith; scholars holding no wudu (Companions, Successors, people of Kufa, Ibn al-Mubarak); at-Tirmidhi calls it the best narrated in its chapter; Darussalam sahih.

sources.title: Sunan Abi Dawud 181 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Marwan and 'Urwah story with Busrah's report; al-Albani sahih.

sources.title: Sunan Abi Dawud 182 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Talq's report of the Bedouin's question after wudu and the reply; al-Albani sahih.

sources.title: Sunan an-Nasa'i 165 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Talq's version where the man touched during the prayer.

sources.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 483 on Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Talq's version: it does not require ablution, it is a part of you; Darussalam sahih.

review.notes: Re-read every capture retrieved 2026-10-30, including at-Tirmidhi's Arabic commentary under 84 and 85. Scholar positions are attributed exactly as at-Tirmidhi lists them (named individuals and 'the people of Kufa'); no madhab-level conditions (palm, barrier, desire, women) are asserted because no checked source states them, and the article says so explicitly. 'Muhammad' in Tirmidhi 84 is identified as al-Bukhari, at-Tirmidhi's teacher, as conventional in the Jami. Gradings in the table are copied from each Sunnah.com page. Tirmidhi 83 returned HTTP 403 and is not cited; Abu Dawud 181 succeeded on retry. Hero generated locally with the sand palette and inspected: 1200x630 legible title card, not duplicated in body. No app CTA; links /prayer-times and existing wudu guides.

claim_checks.claim: Many Companions and Successors, al-Awza'i, ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq held touching the penis requires wudu
claim_checks.explanation: Arabic: wa huwa qawlu ghayri wahidin min ashab an-Nabi wa at-tabi'in wa bihi yaqulu al-Awza'i wa ash-Shafi'i wa Ahmad wa Ishaq.

claim_checks.claim: Al-Bukhari said the most authentic report on the subject is Busrah's; Abu Zur'ah graded Umm Habibah's report sahih
claim_checks.explanation: Arabic: qala Muhammad wa asahhu shay'in fi hadha al-bab hadith Busrah; wa qala Abu Zur'ah hadith Umm Habibah fi hadha al-bab sahih.

claim_checks.claim: Other Companions and Successors, the people of Kufa and Ibn al-Mubarak held no wudu; at-Tirmidhi called Talq's hadith the best narrated in this chapter
claim_checks.explanation: Arabic: lam yaraw al-wudu' min mass adh-dhakar wa huwa qawlu ahl al-Kufa wa Ibn al-Mubarak; wa hadha al-hadith ahsanu shay'in ruwiya fi hadha al-bab.

claim_checks.claim: Busrah: whoever touches his penis is not to pray until he performs wudu; hasan sahih; Darussalam sahih
claim_checks.explanation: English text, Arabic hasan sahih note by Abu Isa and the Darussalam grade line on the page.

claim_checks.claim: Marwan and 'Urwah story; Busrah heard: He who touches his penis should perform ablution; al-Albani sahih
claim_checks.explanation: English narration of the Marwan and Urwah exchange and the Al-Albani sahih grade line.

claim_checks.claim: An-Nasa'i records Busrah's hadith via Marwan and 'Urwah
claim_checks.explanation: Narration text: Urwah entered upon Marwan, who cited Busrah bint Safwan hearing the Prophet.

claim_checks.claim: Ibn Majah records Busrah's hadith, Darussalam hasan
claim_checks.explanation: Narration 'If anyone of you touches his penis, let him perform ablution' and Hasan (Darussalam) grade line.

claim_checks.claim: Talq: a Bedouin asked about touching after wudu; reply: that is only a part of his body; al-Albani sahih
claim_checks.explanation: English narration of the Bedouin's question after ablution, the reply, and the Al-Albani sahih grade line.

claim_checks.claim: In an-Nasa'i's version the man touched during the prayer; reply: it is just a part of you
claim_checks.explanation: English narration: a man who touched his penis during the Salah; reply 'It is just a part of you'.

claim_checks.claim: Ibn Majah: That does not require ablution, because it is a part of you; Darussalam sahih
claim_checks.explanation: English narration from Qais bin Talq's father and the Sahih (Darussalam) grade line.
